latestTerminalSummary:
Full LR remains **unresolved after two attempts**; the campaign stays **4/10**.

The [report](</home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-14/linear-ryser-r2/candidate.md>) records a different, realized two-coordinate \(K_4\) trade. Its saturated form forces \(\mathbf F_4\) geometry. For every \(q=4^n\ge16\), I proved that further two-coordinate pencil exceptions cannot repair its private old vertices, yielding an explicit global \(r-1\) cover. This excludes that gadget’s permitted extensions, not full LR.

[Complete proofs](</home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-14/linear-ryser-r2/k4-checkpoint.md>) and a [separate design-inflation checkpoint](</home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-14/linear-ryser-r2/design-checkpoint.md>) accompany the source contracts and operation comparison.

The scope is byte-identical. The [manifest](</home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-14/linear-ryser-r2/manifest.json>) specifies all **34 files and 6 directories**, roles, sizes and hashes. Correct-anchor verification and wrong-anchor rejection passed under a read-only guard; all 46 fixed external references remained unchanged. Integrity only—no mathematical acceptance claimed.
